newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries end down, data heighten rate fears.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries end down, data heighten rate fears.

text.p: *U.S. Treasuries end lower again on fear Fed will hike rates.
*30-yr yield at highest level in nearly six months.
*Increased fears of March 25 Fed tightening led to selloff
*Chicago Fed's Moskow says pre-emptive Fed policy needed.
*Jump in Feb retail sales, fall in claims sparked Fed view
